title: FHP Candidate Profile
description: The canonical representation of a candidate in the Fair Hiring Protocol. All fields are under candidate control. No inferred or derived fields from third-party sources are permitted.

fhp_version.description: The FHP spec version this profile conforms to.

candidate_id.description: A globally unique, opaque identifier for this candidate. Must be a UUID v4. Never derived from PII.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last profile update.

identity.description: Minimal identity information used for communication only. Never used in matching or scoring.

display_name.description: The name the candidate wishes to be addressed by.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email. Not shared with employers without explicit candidate consent.

contact_phone.description: Optional phone number. E.164 format preferred.

preferred_language.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag for communication preferences.

skills.description: The candidate's skill set. This is the primary matching surface. Each skill must reference an entry in the FHP Skill Ontology.

ontology_id.description: Reference to a skill in the FHP Skill Ontology (e.g. 'fhp:skill:python', 'fhp:skill:project-management').

proficiency.description: Self-assessed proficiency level using the FHP standard scale.

years_of_experience.description: Approximate years of active use. Optional. Not used as a filter — used only to contextualise proficiency.

evidence.description: Optional pointers to evidence of this skill. Does not affect match score directly — used in explanation generation.

work_history.description: Optional narrative work history. Used for context and explanation only — never as a filter. Job titles and employer names are not used in matching.

role_description.description: A free-text description of the role (not a job title). E.g. 'Led backend infrastructure for a payment processing team'.

employer_type.description: Broad category of employer. Used only for context, never for prestige filtering.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM end date. Omit if current role.

skills_used.description: References to ontology skill IDs practised in this role.

preferences.description: Candidate's stated work preferences. Used in preference alignment stage of matching pipeline.

work_modes.description: Acceptable work arrangements, in order of preference.

locations.description: Acceptable work locations. Use ISO 3166-2 region codes or free-text city names.

salary.description: Salary expectations. Ranges are preferred over point values.

privacy.description: Candidate's privacy and consent settings. Governs how their profile may be used.

searchable.description: Whether the candidate's profile can be surfaced to employers in proactive searches.

anonymised_matching.description: If true, identity fields are withheld from employers until the candidate explicitly approves contact.

data_retention_days.description: How long the candidate's data should be retained after their last active session.

consented_at.description: Timestamp of the candidate's explicit consent to the FHP terms.
